intent: Revert to the race 5 geometry: five 16 mm sensors at x = -0.03, -0.015, 0, 0.015, 0.03 with y = 0.06, and unchanged wheels, body and mass. This isolates controller work for the Integrator, since the seven-sensor test (race 6) lowered oval and s-bend without fixing slalom. I expect oval near 20/20, s-bend near 13 to 15/20 and slalom still the main gap, to be addressed by kp, kd and base_speed. I am not considering a further geometry change until a controller change fails to lower slalom line loss below 1. The one geometry idea still open is a small lead move (y about 0.065), which I would only test if oval oscillation stays above 0.25 with oval finishes at 18 or more of 20.
learning: Race 6 showed that adding sensor density within ±0.03 m hurt oval and s-bend, probably because the Integrator's weights and kp were not matched to seven inputs, and it did not reduce slalom line loss. Slalom now looks limited by controller response at speed rather than by sensor reach or coverage. If the next race with the five-sensor layout and controller tuning still shows slalom line loss at 1 or more with max_error at 0.06, the next step is to tune base_speed and kd, not to change geometry.
rationale: Race 6 (seven 16 mm sensors at 10 mm pitch, y = 0.06, score 389.47) was worse than race 5 (five sensors, same lead, score 606.82). Oval fell from 20/20 to 4/20 and s-bend from 15/20 to 7/20, while slalom stayed at 0/20 with line loss rising to 1.25. The denser layout did not fix slalom and damaged the two tracks that were working. The Integrator's rule was to keep the seven-sensor layout only if slalom line loss fell below 1; it did not, so the rule says to hold the geometry and move to gain and speed tuning. I am following that. I am reverting to the race 5 geometry (five 16 mm sensors at x = -0.03 to +0.03, 15 mm pitch, y = 0.06), the best measured platform. The evidence shows the sensor layout is not what limits slalom: widening to ±0.04 m (race 3) and densifying to seven sensors (race 6) both failed to fix it, and the lead move (race 4) helped oval and s-bend. Body, wheels and mass stay unchanged, since the off-track limit is at its 0.06 m floor. I expect this race to return to roughly race 5 performance (around 600) and to give the Integrator a clean baseline for gain and base_speed work on slalom.
